svg.title: Every server module this repository owns, and what each one imports
svg.desc: A left-to-right map of the server side of the application, derived from the imports in the code rather than drawn by hand, so it cannot describe a wiring that no longer exists. Each box is one module; each arrow is one module importing another. Route handlers sit on the left, since every request enters through one of them. The two modules that verify a request and the one that decides whether a person may be contacted are drawn as gates, because their job is to reject. The database schema is drawn as regulated data, because that is what it declares. Test files are excluded: a test importing a module says nothing about how the application is wired. 32 modules and 48 imports are drawn.
